high_level_description: This image depicts a street scene featuring a row of elegant, red-brick terraced houses with ornate architectural details. The buildings have multiple stories, each adorned with large windows and decorative elements such as bay windows, gables, and chimneys. The facades are richly textured, showcasing the craftsmanship typical of historic architecture. The street is relatively quiet, with only a few cars parked along the side. A modern silver car is prominently positioned in the foreground, facing the camera.
